cons: Only useful if already running Falcon

name: CrowdStrike Charlotte AI
pros: Grounded on your organization's own security data
Natural language dramatically lowers analyst query friction
No data leaves the Falcon platform boundary
files: Falcon platform telemetry: endpoint, identity, cloud, and network data.
value: Natural language access to the CrowdStrike Falcon telemetry: ask in English, get an answer grounded in your organization's own security data. Reduces the query burden on analysts and surfaces context that would otherwise require a specialist to retrieve.
engine: Frontier models grounded on CrowdStrike Falcon telemetry and threat intelligence.
latency: Interactive for queries. Continuous monitoring is background.

pricing.includes: Charlotte AI features across licensed Falcon modules

quality: Bounded by the quality and coverage of your Falcon deployment. Better data coverage produces better answers.
tagline: AI across the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, answering security questions in natural language.
use_cases: Asking natural language questions against the organization's security telemetry
Summarising incidents and threat context for analysts under pressure
Accelerating triage by surfacing relevant context without manual hunting
integrations: Deeply embedded in the Falcon platform
governance_note: Security AI tools create an audit question that general AI tools do not: if the AI missed something, was it because the telemetry was incomplete, the model missed it, or the analyst did not ask the right question? Documenting which AI-assisted decisions were made and what they were grounded on matters for incident response and for regulator inquiries in sectors with notification obligations. The AI layer is not a substitute for human judgment on significant incidents; it is a retrieval accelerator.
training_optout: CrowdStrike's terms govern customer data use. Grounding on your own telemetry is the architectural pattern; verify the data retention and training terms in the customer agreement.
